title: Java Programming
description: Enterprise Java engineering covering JVM architecture, OOP, Collections Framework, Streams, Concurrency, and full-stack projects.
outcomes: Master fundamental to advanced concepts in Java Programming.
Build industry-standard applications and capstone projects.
Excel in technical interviews and competitive programming.

modules.title: Java Foundations & JVM Architecture
modules.description: Java history, JDK vs JRE vs JVM, bytecode, class loaders, first Java application, and syntax rules.

modules.title: Variables, Primitive Types & Type Casting
modules.description: Primitive data types, wrapper classes, variables, constants, type casting (widening & narrowing), and memory allocation.

modules.title: Operators & Mathematical Operations
modules.description: Arithmetic, logical, relational, bitwise, assignment, ternary operators, and java.lang.Math.

modules.title: Input/Output & Scanner Class
modules.description: Scanner class, BufferedReader, System.out.println, formatted printing (printf), and command-line arguments.

modules.title: Control Flow: Conditionals & Switches
modules.description: if, if-else, nested if, switch statement, and enhanced switch expressions.

modules.title: Control Flow: Loops & Iterations
modules.description: while, do-while, for loops, for-each (enhanced for), break, continue, and nested loops.

modules.title: Methods, Scope & Recursion
modules.description: Method declaration, parameters, return types, method overloading, static vs instance methods, pass-by-value, and recursion.

modules.title: Arrays & Multi-Dimensional Matrices
modules.description: 1D arrays, 2D arrays, jagged arrays, array manipulation, Arrays utility class, and matrix operations.

modules.title: Strings, StringBuilder & StringBuffer
modules.description: String immutability, String pool, String methods, StringBuilder vs StringBuffer, and regex operations.

modules.title: Object-Oriented Programming: Classes & Objects
modules.description: Classes, objects, constructors (default, parameterized, copy), this keyword, encapsulation, and garbage collection.

modules.title: OOP: Inheritance, Polymorphism & Interfaces
modules.description: Inheritance types, super keyword, method overriding, dynamic method dispatch, abstract classes, and interfaces.

modules.title: Packages, Encapsulation & Access Modifiers
modules.description: public, private, protected, default package-private, custom packages, JARs, and module system.

modules.title: Exception Handling & Robust Code
modules.description: try, catch, finally, throw, throws, checked vs unchecked exceptions, custom exception classes, and try-with-resources.

modules.title: Java Collections Framework
modules.description: List (ArrayList, LinkedList), Set (HashSet, TreeSet), Queue, Map (HashMap, TreeMap), iterators, and Collections algorithms.

modules.title: Generics, Lambdas & Java Streams
modules.description: Generic classes and methods, wildcards, functional interfaces, lambda expressions, Stream API (map, filter, reduce), and Optionals.

modules.title: File I/O, NIO & Serialization
modules.description: File class, FileReader/FileWriter, FileInputStream/FileOutputStream, Serializable interface, and java.nio.file.

modules.title: Multithreading & Concurrency Basics
modules.description: Thread class, Runnable interface, thread lifecycle, synchronization, deadlock, and ExecutorService.

modules.title: Problem Solving & Enterprise Java Projects
modules.description: Algorithmic drills, coding challenges, Student Information System, ATM Simulation, and full-stack capstones.
